prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original 32-bit arcade pixel-art selectable fighting-game stage background, STRIKE LEDGER / AFTER HOURS.
Primary request: MARIST GATES — BLUE HOUR. A recognizable artistic adaptation of Marist College's real South Gate in Poughkeepsie, as a flat traditional 1v1 fighting stage.
Input image1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, existing original AFTER HOURS foundry stage. Match its crisp pixel clusters, granular but controlled texture, clean stepped edges, ink-blue shadows, limited cream/amber/oxidized teal shading ramps and late-1990s 32-bit arcade craftsmanship. Do NOT put foundry machinery in this outdoor setting.
Input image2: ARCHITECTURAL REFERENCE ONLY, official photograph of Marist South Gate. Preserve recognizability of this specific asymmetric structure: tall square pier at LEFT with pale carved fox relief panel; one ROUND pedestrian arch to its RIGHT, chunky limestone arch surround with narrow red-brick band; grey-blue irregular ashlar stone walls, light limestone caps, horizontal carved round-medallion frieze across top of arch, a lower short right pier. It is not a symmetric cathedral gate, not a pointed Gothic arch and not a castle.
Composition: create one clean full-bleed landscape16:9 game background, requested1536x864. Camera side-on across broad uninterrupted bluestone/brick campus-entry plaza. Place complete arch in the MIDDLE BACKGROUND slightly left of center (arch opening centered43% width); tall carved pier at roughly27% width, top at12% height, arch base at73% height. Campus path and trees visible through arch. At far right background, a low grey stone campus sign wall with the exact readable word 'MARIST' in inset limestone lettering; behind it black iron railing, quiet campus trees and small deep-background lit windows. Low shrub beds behind fighting plane, no shrubs across foreground. One tasteful burgundy campus pennant far left and one warm brass campus lamppost far right. Distant street recedes at far left, no cars.
Mood: early autumn BLUE HOUR after light rain, damp pavers with short pixel-sharp amber reflections, navy/teal tree canopy, pale stone catches warm lamplight, a few scattered copper leaves at far corners. Atmospheric and lived-in; brighter than the foundry just enough to read masonry, with lower-contrast dark greenery at character-torso height. No sunset orange sky; use ink-blue twilight with sparse flat cloud shapes.
Gameplay framing: broad perfectly FLAT fighting floor begins at74% canvas height, horizontal fighter feet baseline at84% height, uninterrupted foreground to bottom. No steps, platforms, pits, barriers, railings, people or props in the fighting plane. Grounded 1v1 side-view arena; the gate and stone walls are purely background scenery. Keep the top10% and bottom HUD margins visually quiet.
Style constraints: genuine visible PIXEL ART, no antialiasing, soft glow, smooth painterly gradients, blur, glossy 3D or vector look. Three-to-five color ramps per material, strong individual stone pixel clusters. Palette anchored #111923 #263B48 #69B8AC #EDAA54 #F4E5C5 with restrained muted brick-red accents. Original composition, not a pixel-filtered copy of the photo.
Text: only the environmental stone sign 'MARIST'; no title, HUD, fighters, watermark, border or UI. Show the full architecture, do not crop its tall pier.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: full-world horizontal camera-pan background for traditional1v1 fighting-game stage MARIST GATES — BLUE HOUR.
Input image is the approved stage artwork; use it as the edit target. Extend the world to the LEFT and RIGHT to form one EXTRA-WIDE PANORAMA of aspect128:45 (approximately2.844:1), requested2048x720 or same ratio larger. Keep existing central gate, wall sign 'MARIST', lighting, stone texture, trees and fullheight composition faithful. Preserve the original stage as the middle62.5% of the wider composition, do not merely stretch it. Add matching quiet campus scenery to both sides: extra receding dark tree canopy, low iron fence and small stone boundary piers, a subdued lamp and fallen copper leaves at extreme edges. The original gate should occupy the center of the expanded WORLD, with its ROUND ARCH and taller LEFT carved pier unchanged, all fully visible. Keep path visible through arch; no new gate copies, no extra huge buildings or rival focal points.
Critical: broad perfectly flat combat foreground continuous across the ENTIRE panorama at the same height, feet baseline at approximately83.89% ofheight (604of720;302of360). No slopes, steps, props, foliage, obstacles or people on that line. Foreground pavers continue tobottom, same perspective and pixel-size texture across expansions. Sufficient headroom for HUD and jumps in both extremes. The center62.5% viewport should look like approved image without radically different architecture.
Retain original32-bit arcade pixel art: crisp chunky small pixel clusters, ink-blue shadows, pale cream ashlar and limestone caps, narrow brick arch-band, medallion frieze, restrained amber campuslamps, teal/navy trees, darkwet pavement with short hard amber reflections. Do not smooth, blur or add photorealism, gradients, HUD, fighters, titlecard, border or watermark. Opaque full-bleed source artwork. Source is singleflattened landscape; don't show layer diagrams.
